$comment: The tour of the first-red colony (/c/first-red?tour=1), on its replay; the same keys and fields as tour.json. Its moments (tour/firstRed.ts, found in the record's certify, landing and bisect events): @green (the first green certification result), @held (the last landing between the green result and the red one; the step is about the landing that broke the tests), @red (the red result), @search (the bisect event: the first red search ended), @repair (an agent took the repair intent the red result declared, else its declaration), @repair-landed (the landing that carried the repair intent), @green-again (the first green result after the red one), @start, @end. Captions are filled once, at the moment: {greenSha} {greenTests} {greenMs} {heldLandings} {heldCommits} {heldSpan} {brokeOrdinal} {brokeIntent} {brokeFile} {brokeSha} {brokeLanding} {brokeProposal} {redSha} {redAfterGreen} {redMs} {failing} {failingNames} {failingError} {runs} {searchMs} {sinceGreen} {repairTitle} {repairAgent} {repairWhyLine} {repairFile} {repairSettledBy} {afterRed} {greenAgainSha} {greenAgainTests} {greenAfterRed} {colony}.

steps.caption: Trunk certified green on {greenSha}: {greenTests} in {greenMs}, the project's own tests run by trunk certification after the landing.
{heldLandings} landed in {heldCommits} over {heldSpan} while certification was held, and no test ran on any of them; the {brokeOrdinal}, {brokeIntent}, changed {brokeFile}.
Certification ran again on the head {redSha}, {redAfterGreen} after the green result, and went red: {failing} failing, {failingNames}{failingError}.

The search ran the failing test alone at earlier commits, {runs} in {searchMs} over the {sinceGreen} since green, and named the {brokeOrdinal} landing: commit {brokeSha}, landing {brokeLanding}, intent {brokeIntent}, proposal {brokeProposal}, which changed {brokeFile}.
{repairAgent} took the repair intent the red result declared, “{repairTitle}”{repairWhyLine}.
The repair landed {afterRed} after the red result, in {repairFile}, settled by {repairSettledBy}.
Trunk certified green again on {greenAgainSha}, {greenAfterRed} after the red result: {greenAgainTests}, and the result rides with the commit in its lineage note.
